correctness.rationale: For n>=4, End(V) under conjugation decomposes multiplicity-free into scalar, standard, (n-2,2) and wedge² constituents. For class with f fixed points and t transpositions, trace projection gives L_0=(f-1)^2/(n-1), L_1=f(n-f)/[(n-1)(n-2)], L_3=(n-f-2t)/[(n-1)(n-2)] and L_2 by symmetric energy subtraction. All five allowed types (id,T,C3,D22,C4) are exhausted by support <=4 moved symbols. The proof supplies explicit classwise rational inequalities L_1 or L_0>=K[pL_2+(1-p)L_3] for n=5,6 and n>=7, giving universal lower bounds over *any central mixture*. Explicit class mixtures attain them with no zero level, n=4 achieving exact tightness. Checked sector levels and witness eigenvalue ratios independently using exact rational arithmetic at n=4,5,6,7,8,20,100, including all three exceptional levels and n>=7 rational formula. Infinite-range positive-polynomial inequalities, not finite checking, justify n>=7.
